name: Hillshade
description: A field of low pyramids lit from the upper left, every apex pushed off center by a smooth field so the faces swell and shrink like shaded relief.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --px: @rn(-10, 110, 1.2); --py: @rn(-10, 110, 1.2); --x: $(max(12, min(88, px))); --y: $(max(12, min(88, py))); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, $(x)% $(y)%); clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, $(x)% $(y)%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 100%, 0 100%, $(x)% $(y)%); clip-path: polygon(100% 100%, 0 100%, $(x)% $(y)%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
